handoffs.message: TEL-001 complete: telemetry schema (v2) carries all binding/stage evidence fields. capture.py injects binding_context (binding_id, deployment_stage, plan_id, persona_capital_binding_id, artifact_id, artifact_version, runtime_id) into every event. New capture methods for deploy/rollback/kill-switch/heartbeat events. 31/31 unit tests pass, smoke test passes. Schema validated. Ready for Codex review.

Review requested changes. See services/telemetry/review_tel001_codex_zh.md. Blockers: (1) deploy/rollback/kill-switch/heartbeat helpers emit empty metrics and fail canonical telemetry_event.schema.json; (2) binding evidence is still optional/fabricated because capture.py backfills missing RuntimeBinding fields with defaults/empty strings instead of rejecting; (3) deployment_stage=frozen maps to execution_mode=frozen, which violates the schema's paper|live alias contract; (4) TEL-001 tests/smoke still validate against ad-hoc minimal schemas, so canonical regressions are not covered.

All 4 review blockers resolved. (1) deploy/rollback/kill-switch/heartbeat now emit canonical non-empty metrics passing minProperties=1. (2) Partial binding_context triggers strict rejection instead of fabricating defaults. (3) frozen deployment_stage correctly maps to paper execution_mode. (4) Tests and smoke test unified to canonical telemetry_event.schema.json. Also fixed runtime_binding_id → binding_id naming drift in LINEAGE_AND_TELEMETRY_STORAGE_DECISIONS.md. All 58 unit tests + smoke test pass.
